Version 0.2 (Updated: 01.06.2026)

This Blueprint is made with Bob Mod 2.x for Space Age / Factorio 2.x.

It contains Flare Stack for 2.0 (Link: https://mods.factorio.com/mod/Flare_Stack_SA ) and is optimized for grid use in 10 Books Full of Rails V2.23.0 (Link: https://github.com/Opinionated-Blueprints/10-Books-Full-of-Rails/wiki )

I suggest Enable all Bob Mods (Link: https://mods.factorio.com/mod/kry-all-bobs-mods )

Every modification or improvement, made by others, are welcome to post them, im doing it only for my own interrest, so progress could be slow
